title: Answer Convergence as a Signal for Early Stopping in Reasoning
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: Stops CoT when partial-chain answers stabilize, optionally using logit adjustment or a learned stop predictor.
当部分思维链的答案趋于稳定时提前终止推理，可选配 logit 调整或学习式停止预测器。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: It separates answer stability from verified correctness when selecting trace prefixes.
inclusion_reason: Makes partial-trace stabilization a measurable stop signal with explicit correctness limits.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long chain-of-thought decoding can continue after a model's predicted answer has stabilized. The paper asks how much of an explicit reasoning trace is needed before the model reaches the same answer it would give after full decoding, and whether that signal can stop generation without gold labels. The data object is a full reasoning trace split into sentence-level prefixes, plus the answer elicited from every prefix, convergence labels or activation features, and the chosen stopping point. Answer stability is a self-consistency property; it is not evidence that the stabilized answer is correct.
长链式思维解码可能在模型预测答案已经稳定后继续生成。论文研究：显式推理轨迹需要生成到什么位置，模型才会给出与完整解码相同的答案；以及能否在没有黄金标签的情况下利用该信号提前停止。相关数据对象是按句子切分的完整推理轨迹、从每个前缀诱导出的答案、收敛标签或激活特征，以及最终停止位置。答案稳定属于自一致性性质，不代表稳定后的答案正确。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The study defines the Answer Convergence Ratio as the earliest sentence-prefix fraction after which all subsequent prefix answers match the full-trace answer. It then proposes three stopping mechanisms. Answer Consistency periodically appends an end-of-reasoning marker at sentence boundaries and stops after the same greedily decoded answer repeats for a fixed number of chunks. Think Token Adjustment increases the end-of-reasoning token logit at likely boundaries. Learn-to-Stop trains an LSTM over final-layer activations; prefixes before the earliest stable point are labeled 0 and that point onward 1. All three predict when to stop, while answer correctness remains an external evaluation outcome.

论文将答案收敛率定义为：从某个句子前缀开始，后续所有前缀答案都与完整轨迹答案一致，该最早位置占完整轨迹的比例。随后提出三种停止机制。Answer Consistency 在句子边界临时加入结束推理标记，当贪心解码出的同一答案连续出现指定次数时停止；Think Token Adjustment 在可能的边界提高结束推理 token 的 logit；Learn-to-Stop 用 LSTM 编码末层激活，最早稳定点之前标为 0、从该点起标为 1。三种方法都只预测何时停止，答案正确性仍是外部评测结果。

title: Method
方法
html:
For the preliminary analysis, each model-generated CoT is segmented with the NLTK sentence tokenizer. Prefixes are built cumulatively; an end-of-reasoning marker is appended, and the model greedily produces a partial answer from each prefix. The earliest prefix whose answer remains identical through the final prefix defines the convergence label. The supervised variant records final-layer activations at chunk boundaries, feeds their sequence to an LSTM and sigmoid classifier, trains with binary cross-entropy, and tunes its stop threshold on validation data. The two unsupervised variants instead use repeated partial answers or an adaptive logit boost and do not modify the base model.

Experiments cover NaturalQuestions, GSM8K, MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, and AIME 2024 with five open-weight models from R1-distilled Qwen/Llama and QwQ families. Reported outputs include accuracy, generated tokens, token reduction, convergence ratios, and stopping decisions. The paper provides an ACL record and a Hugging Face Space link, but this Card has not verified a downloadable release containing the chunked traces, prefix answers, activation tensors, train/validation labels, learned stopper weights, exact thresholds, seeds, or per-example stop logs; those artifacts remain unknown or unavailable.

初步分析先用 NLTK 句子分词器切分模型生成的 CoT，再逐步累积前缀；每个前缀后加入结束推理标记，并让模型用贪心解码产生部分答案。若从某个最早前缀开始，答案一直与最终前缀答案相同，则该位置成为收敛标签。监督式方法在句子边界记录末层激活，把激活序列送入 LSTM 与 sigmoid 分类器，以二元交叉熵训练，并在验证集上选择停止阈值。两个无监督变体则使用重复部分答案或自适应 logit 提升，不修改基础模型参数。

实验覆盖 NaturalQuestions、GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond 与 AIME 2024，使用 R1 蒸馏 Qwen/Llama 和 QwQ 系列的五个开源权重模型。报告对象包括准确率、生成 token、token 降幅、收敛率和停止决策。论文有 ACL 正式记录及 Hugging Face Space 链接，但本卡尚未核验到包含分块轨迹、前缀答案、激活张量、训练/验证标签、stopper 权重、精确阈值、随机种子和逐样本停止日志的可下载发布；这些工件仍为 unknown 或不可得。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that convergence often occurs before the full trace, with the distribution shifting later as task difficulty increases. Across five benchmarks and five model settings, the three methods are evaluated by final accuracy and token use; Learn-to-Stop is generally more robust on harder tasks, while answer consistency and token adjustment work best on lower-reasoning-demand tasks. NaturalQuestions results include token reductions above 40% in some settings, and the paper also studies model size, hyperparameters, and faithfulness of truncated traces.

These experiments evaluate stopping policies, not a training-data release. Matching the full-trace answer cannot show that either answer is correct, and preserved benchmark accuracy cannot certify the semantic validity of every truncated prefix or learned label. Manual faithfulness analysis is limited and does not replace record-level verification.

论文报告答案往往在完整轨迹结束前收敛，且任务越难，收敛位置分布通常越靠后。三种方法在五个基准和五种模型设置上以最终准确率与 token 使用量评测；Learn-to-Stop 在困难任务上通常更稳健，而答案一致性和 token 调整更适合推理需求较低的任务。NaturalQuestions 的部分设置报告超过 40% 的 token 降幅，论文还分析模型规模、超参数及截断轨迹的忠实性。

这些实验评估的是停止策略，而不是训练数据发布。与完整轨迹答案一致不能说明两个答案都正确；保持 benchmark 准确率也不能认证每个截断前缀或学习标签在语义上有效。有限的人工忠实性分析不能替代逐记录验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior efficiency work uses fixed token budgets, concise prompts, length-aware training, or external confidence. This paper makes prefix-answer convergence an explicit inference-time control object and compares three ways to operationalize it: repeated-output stability, end-token logit adjustment, and an activation-based learned stopper. The distinctive supervision for Learn-to-Stop is derived from the model's own final answer rather than gold correctness. Sentence segmentation, greedy decoding, LSTM classification, and early exit are not individually new. The direction signal is the trace schema linking prefix, partial answer, activation, convergence label, stop decision, and final outcome.

既有高效推理工作使用固定 token 预算、简洁提示、长度感知训练或外部置信度。本文把“前缀答案收敛”显式化为推理时控制对象，并比较三种实现：重复输出稳定性、结束 token 的 logit 调整，以及基于激活的学习式 stopper。Learn-to-Stop 的监督来自模型自身最终答案，而不是黄金正确性。句子切分、贪心解码、LSTM 分类和提前退出本身都不是新技术。其方向性信号在于建立前缀、部分答案、激活、收敛标签、停止决策与最终结果之间的轨迹模式。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Convergence can lock in a wrong answer, especially on GPQA or AIME-like tasks, and the supervised labels reproduce the full model's own mistakes. Sentence boundaries and answer normalization are format-sensitive; repeated equivalent answers may be written differently, while identical strings may hide different reasoning. Think-token adjustment depends on a model exposing a compatible reasoning terminator. Activation-based stopping requires model access and a separately trained predictor for each representation regime.

Premature truncation can make the visible rationale unfaithful to the returned answer. Results cover five benchmarks and selected model families; transfer to other languages, open-ended generation, tool use, or different decoding settings remains unknown. Complete derived traces, labels, activations, thresholds, stopper checkpoints, licenses, contamination checks, and replay manifests are not established as public artifacts.

答案收敛可能把错误答案固定下来，尤其是在 GPQA 或 AIME 一类困难任务上；监督标签也会复制完整模型自身的错误。句子边界和答案规范化对格式敏感：等价答案可能写法不同，相同字符串也可能掩盖不同推理。Think Token Adjustment 还依赖模型提供兼容的推理结束标记；基于激活的停止需要访问内部表示，并可能为不同表示体系重新训练预测器。

过早截断会使可见理由与返回答案不忠实。实验只覆盖五个基准和若干模型系列，能否迁移到其他语言、开放式生成、工具使用或不同解码设置仍为 unknown。完整派生轨迹、标签、激活、阈值、stopper 检查点、许可证、污染检查和重放清单都未被确认是公开工件。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
The work supplies a schema for early-exit reasoning records. An auditable example should preserve the source prompt and split, full trace, sentence boundaries, every prefix, temporary end marker, normalized partial answer, convergence sequence, final full-trace answer, gold outcome when available, activation revision, stopper score, threshold, selected stopping point, saved tokens, and faithfulness review. These fields support calibration of false-early-stop and missed-stop errors across difficulty.

Reuse must keep stability, full-trace agreement, benchmark correctness, and rationale faithfulness as separate signals. The reported efficiency gains justify studying the controller; they do not establish that unreleased prefix labels or truncated traces are high-quality post-training data.

该工作为提前退出推理记录提供了 schema。可审计样本应保留源提示与划分、完整轨迹、句子边界、每个前缀、临时结束标记、规范化部分答案、收敛序列、完整轨迹最终答案、可用时的黄金结果、激活版本、stopper 分数、阈值、所选停止点、节省 token 及忠实性审查。借助这些字段，可以按难度校准错误早停与漏停。

复用时必须把稳定性、与完整轨迹一致、benchmark 正确性和理由忠实性作为不同信号。论文的效率提升说明控制器值得研究，但不能证明未公开的前缀标签或截断轨迹是高质量后训练数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish answer stability from correctness and from rationale faithfulness.
  • Preserve all prefix answers and normalization rules, not only the selected stopping point.
  • Audit false early stops separately on easy and hard tasks and across model sizes.
  • Treat Learn-to-Stop labels as self-derived agreement labels rather than gold process supervision.
  • Verify release of chunked traces, activations, thresholds, and stopper weights before claiming reuse.

• 区分答案稳定、答案正确与理由忠实性。
  • 保存全部前缀答案及规范化规则，不要只保存最终停止点。
  • 按任务难度与模型规模分别审计错误早停。
  • 将 Learn-to-Stop 标签视为自生成一致性标签，而不是黄金过程监督。
  • 声称可复用前，应核验分块轨迹、激活、阈值和 stopper 权重是否发布。
